Heat a pan with a tablespoon of oil over a medium heat. Add a teaspoon of curry powder and FRY IT FOR 30 SECONDS IN THE OIL before adding anything else: raw it tastes of powder, fried it releases its aroma. This quick version skips the sofrito.
Calienta una sartén con una cucharadita: Heat a pan with a teaspoon of oil over a medium heat. Lay the thighs skin side down and leave them for 6 or 7 minutes without moving them, until the skin is golden and crisp and has rendered its fat.
Calienta una sartén o plancha a fuego me: Heat a pan or griddle over a medium-high heat with a teaspoon of oil. Cook the hake for 3 minutes a side, turning it ONCE and carefully: it falls apart. Done when it flakes.

Heat a small pan over a medium heat with a tablespoon of oil. Tip in the mixture, turn the heat down and leave it for 4 minutes, easing the edge away with the spatula.
Calienta una sartén pequeña antiadherent: Heat a small non-stick pan over a medium heat with a little oil. It is ready when a drop of egg sizzles gently as it lands.
Caliéntalas en una sartén con una cuchar: Warm them in a pan with a tablespoon of oil and two tablespoons of water, 2 minutes, shaking the pan rather than stirring.
Warm them in a pan with a tablespoon of oil and two tablespoons of water, 2 minutes, shaking the pan; add the cooked pasta and fold it in carefully.
Caliéntalo 90 segundos a máxima potencia: Heat it for 90 seconds on full power.
Caliéntalos 2 minutos en un cazo con un: Warm them for 2 minutes in a pan with a finger of water, or 1 minute in the microwave. Just warmed through, not boiling.

Mince over a high heat WITHOUT stirring for 1 minute; break it up and fry for 5 minutes. If it releases water, turn the heat up until it evaporates or it stews grey.
Carne picada en la misma sartén a fuego: Mince into the same pan over a high heat WITHOUT stirring for 1 minute; break it up and fry for 5 minutes. If it releases water, turn the heat up until it evaporates.
Casca el huevo en una taza (nunca direct: Crack the egg into a cup (never straight into the water, this way you control how it goes in).

Crack the egg into a cup and slide it into the pan. DO NOT TOUCH IT; with a spoon, baste the hot oil over the white so it sets without turning it. 2 minutes, runny yolk.
Casca los huevos en un bol y bátelos con: Crack the eggs into a bowl and beat them with a pinch of salt until no threads of clear white are left.
Crack the eggs into a bowl and beat them with a fork for about 20 seconds, until white and yolk are a single yellow colour. Add a pinch of salt.

Mushrooms sliced (wipe them with paper, not under the tap). Fry them over a high heat for 5 minutes until they release their water and it evaporates again. Take them out.

Close it, press with your palm for a few seconds and cut it diagonally: it is easier to hold and to eat.
Ciérralo y córtalo en diagonal si lo vas: Close it and cut it diagonally if you are taking it with you: it holds together better and is easier to eat.
Cocina 3 minutos exactos para que la yem: Cook for exactly 3 minutes for a runny yolk. Lift it out with a slotted spoon and rest it a moment on kitchen paper.

Cauliflower in small florets, 5 minutes in salted boiling water; drain it THE MOMENT it gives, because it turns to mush in no time.
Coloca el pavo encima, doblando las lonc: Lay the turkey on top, folding the slices over on themselves rather than laying them flat: it eats better and does not slide off.
Coloca el pollo y NO LO TOQUES 4 minutos: Lay the chicken down and DO NOT TOUCH IT for 4 minutes. Moving it sooner stops the golden crust forming and makes it stick to the pan.
Coloca el salmón ahumado por encima form: Lay the smoked salmon on top in loose folds rather than flat: it has more presence that way and does not slide off.
Coloca los bastones en una sola línea so: Lay the sticks in a single line across the third nearest to you.
Coloca los lomos de bacalao sobre la sal: Lay the cod fillets on the sauce, cover and leave for 8 minutes over a low heat: it cooks in the steam from the sauce, there is no need to turn it.
Come el jamón con el kiwi: lo dulce y ác: Eat the ham with the kiwi: the sweet-sour fruit cuts the saltiness of the ham, in the same way melon does.
Come los granos con las tortitas de arro: Eat the grains with the rice cakes alongside. Flaky salt over the edamame.
Come sobre un plato: al morder suelta tr: Eat it over a plate: it drops pieces as you bite.

Cómelo al momento. Si lo dejas hecho, el: Eat it straight away. Left made up, the banana browns and the bread goes soft.
Cómelo enseguida, mientras el contraste: Eat it straight away, while the contrast between the crisp bread and the cold ricotta is still there.
Cómelo pronto. Si es para llevar, envuél: Eat it soon. If it is to take with you, wrap it well and add the tomato just before eating.
Cómelo sin esperar, mientras los copos s: Eat it without waiting, while the flakes are still crisp. This is a breakfast with a three-minute shelf life.

Check the avocado by pressing near the stem: it should give a little. Hard, it will not ripen on the plate.
Comprueba el kiwi apretándolo suavemente: Check the kiwi by squeezing it gently: it should give a little. Rock hard it is sour and rasps the tongue.

Con leche se pega MÁS que con agua y pue: With milk it sticks MORE than with water and can boil over suddenly: turn the heat down if you see it bubbling up at the edges.

Cut the turkey into strips and mix everything together.

Corta el pavo en tiras, sécalo con papel: Cut the turkey into strips, pat it dry with paper and salt it just before cooking.
Corta el pavo en tiras, sécalo y sálalo: Cut the turkey into strips, pat it dry and salt it just before cooking.
Cut the turkey into strips, pat it dry and salt it just before it goes in the pan.

Cut the turkey and the cheese into strips.
